title: Under Frequency the renewals table's Promote and Cancel use kit buttons, and every admin console table is one labelled keyboard stop

source.ref: Frequency design system build handoff 2026-10-14, area 5 (cut from #3436 to fit the file gate).

detail: MembershipPromoteButton and MembershipCancelButton branch on SITE_DESIGN: under Frequency the trigger, Keep and Promote are btn sm txt and Confirm is btn sm ink; DAWN markup is unchanged. The .tbl-wrap scrollers in contacts, memberships, economy, moderation (resolved reports and blocked members) and standing get tabIndex 0 and an accessible name, as Overview's already had, so a keyboard can scroll a wide table on a phone; standing keeps its tabpanel role and is named for the board it shows.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const bad=[];if(!/fq [?] 'btn sm ink'/.test(r('components/spaces/membership-cancel-button.tsx')))bad.push('the renewals Confirm is not the kit ink button under Frequency');if(!/'btn sm txt'/.test(r('components/spaces/membership-promote-button.tsx')))bad.push('Promote is not a kit button under Frequency');for(const f of ['contacts/contacts-table','memberships/memberships-body','economy/economy-body','moderation/report-queue','standing/leaderboard']){const s=r('components/frequency/admin/pages/'+f+'.tsx');const all=(s.match(/className=\"panel tbl-wrap\"[^>]*>/g)||[]);if(all.length===0||all.some((t)=>!/tabIndex=[{]0[}]/.test(t)||!/aria-label=/.test(t)))bad.push(f+' has a table a keyboard cannot reach');}if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-926: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
